dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: North Wharf Ad
dialogues.text: Ningguang has recently approved the construction of three additional docks for The Crux to anchor at and conduct repairs.

dialogues.speaker: North Wharf Ad
dialogues.text: All sailors and wharf warehouse staff should prepare accordingly.
